description: Scan tickets at the doors; admit about 2,000 to 3,200 people in the 60 to 90 minutes before a Hall show
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Attendee safety: a queue of 2,000+ people outside the doors creates crowd pressure; a show cannot start late by more than about an hour; the scan manifest is downloaded to scanners before doors, so no data is lost
source_evidence: EV-049 (Operations Director interview); EV-013 (offline scanning from the manifest); EV-046 (attendance per show)
manual_workaround: Printed manifests checked by name and order number; wristbands; security supervisors hold the line (procedure to be written; R-034)
dependent_systems: SYS-01 (manifest and scanning); SYS-09 scanners; SYS-08 Wi-Fi
dependent_people_or_facilities: Door staff; security supervisors; the building

description: Radios, CCTV monitoring, staff door access, and emergency communications on event days
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Doors cannot open without radios and staff door access; CCTV loss is tolerated for one show with extra guards posted; video older than 24 hours matters only for investigations
source_evidence: EV-049 (Operations Director interview); EV-042 (CCTV retention); EV-007 (staffing contractor agreements)
manual_workaround: Extra guards at unmonitored areas; manual key control; radio-only coordination
dependent_third_parties: Network and security integrator; staffing contractors

description: Card-only sales at 26 fixed points and 12 handhelds during shows (cashless venue)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $32,000 of food and beverage sales in an average Hall show, most in the 2 hours around doors and intermission; transactions are held by the POS vendor, so no data is lost
source_evidence: EV-049 (Food and Beverage Manager interview); EV-046 (food and beverage sales per Hall show); EV-028 (P2PE readers)
manual_workaround: Offline card acceptance if allowed by the P2PE solution's instruction manual (to be confirmed with the POS vendor); otherwise close bars

business_process: Box office sales and phone orders
description: Window sales on show days and weekday phone orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Box office opens 2 hours before doors on show days; walk-up and will-call must work before doors; phone orders can wait a day
source_evidence: EV-049 (Director of Ticketing interview); EV-024 (box office and phone order volume)
manual_workaround: Will-call from printed lists; direct walk-up buyers to the online checkout on their phones

description: Online sales through the vendor-hosted pages, including high-demand on-sales with the virtual queue
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A failed on-sale loses demand and trust quickly and can breach artist agreements that set the on-sale time; regular sales can wait hours; orders are kept by the vendor
source_evidence: EV-049 (Director of Ticketing interview); EV-024 (online order volume); EV-026 (vendor recovery commitments)
manual_workaround: Reschedule the on-sale with notice to the artist and patrons

description: Settle each show on the night (ticket, bar, and fee splits) and pay artists and promoters
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Artists expect settlement sheets on show night and payment within agreed terms; a missed settlement damages booking relationships; settlement data can be rebuilt from ticketing and POS reports
source_evidence: EV-049 (Controller interview); EV-046 (settlement summary); EV-019 (backup schedule)
manual_workaround: Spreadsheet settlement from ticketing and POS reports; pay the next business day
dependent_systems: SYS-05 settlement app; SYS-01 reports; SYS-03 reports; SYS-12

description: Lighting, audio, and video for shows; touring crews connect their own equipment
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A show stops if audio or lighting fails; consoles run standalone and show files are kept on the consoles and on USB copies
manual_workaround: Consoles run without the network; touring productions usually bring their own

description: Website event calendar, email campaigns, and urgent notices such as cancellations and weather delays
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cancellation and weather notices must reach ticket holders before doors; the ticketing platform can also email buyers of a show
manual_workaround: Ticketing platform buyer emails; social media posts; signs at the venue

description: Room holds calendar, offers, and rental contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Offers and contracts have deadlines of days, not hours
manual_workaround: Email and phone; paper calendar kept by the booking staff

description: Bookkeeping, vendor payments, and biweekly payroll for 60 employees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Payroll runs biweekly; missing it has legal and retention impact; staffing contractors bill weekly
manual_workaround: Repeat the prior payroll through the payroll provider
